question: What extraordinary power manifests during muttering focused on the image?
premises: Muttering occurs in relation to an image
It takes place in that context
Breaking of pots and stones occurs
inference: In that muttering upon the image, there is the power to break pots and stones

plain_english: In that muttering upon the image, pots and stones can be shattered.
